label: Episode 46
logline: The High Priest places the sanctuary under Crown seizure and invalidates Alexander and Juliana's wedding for lack of royal license, prompting Alexander to demand a ten-day ecclesiastical trial while Catherine schemes to destroy them.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 45's cliffhanger where the High Priest stormed into the church with royal guards and challenged the legality of Alexander and Juliana's marriage.
notes: no clip met the brief; best effort returned

picks.logline: The High Priest places the sanctuary under Crown seizure and invalidates Alexander and Juliana's wedding for lack of royal license, prompting Alexander to demand a ten-day ecclesiastical trial while Catherine schemes to destroy them.
picks.hook: "God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!"

picks.transcript:
CLIP: episode 46, 2 segment(s), 32s
-- segment 1: 01:21.10 to 01:36.45 --
[01:21.10-01:25.50] JULIANA (Shouting, Triumphant): "God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!"
[01:25.80-01:29.20] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine leaning against a stone archway, whispering with venomous mockery.
[01:26.10-01:29.00] CATHERINE (Malicious, Taunting): "Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you."
[01:29.20-01:32.50] CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.
[01:29.30-01:32.40] HIGH PRIEST (O.S. / Low, Threatening): "Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness."
[01:32.20-01:36.20] HIGH PRIEST (Commanding, Severe): "God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!"
[01:32.50-01:36.00] CAMERA: Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.
[01:36.00-01:36.45] CAMERA: Brief insert of Catherine smirking as she watches from the side.
-- segment 2: 02:07.20 to 02:23.88 --
[02:07.20-02:13.50] CAMERA: Wide shot from behind the guards as they surround Alexander and Juliana, halberds and swords pointed inches from Alexander's chest.
[02:07.20-02:13.20] ALEXANDER (Thunderous, Imposing): "Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!"
[02:13.50-02:18.80] CAMERA: Medium shot of the High Priest extending his hand toward the guards, commanding them to stand down.
[02:14.00-02:16.00] ACTION: The guards slowly lower their weapon points away from the Duke.
[02:14.20-02:18.50] HIGH PRIEST (Ominous, Warning): "Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well."
[02:18.80-02:20.50] CAMERA: The High Priest turns sharply on his heel and strides past the guards toward the church exit.
[02:19.00-02:22.00] SOUND: Shuffling boots and clattering armor as the royal guards turn and retreat down the ruined aisle.
[02:20.50-02:23.88] CAMERA: Slow pan to Catherine standing in her bridal gown beside the sunlit aisle, watching the priest depart before turning to camera with a wicked, predatory smile.
[02:21.20-02:23.80] CATHERINE (Whispering, Malicious): "Ten days is plenty of time."
